activation_attempts.finding: the service starts and reports the same product revision as the archive; the host reaches the vendor over the network
activation_attempts.route: the route the delivered activation guide documents for this platform, run from the delivered activation directory with the delivered configuration unchanged (mode=single, trial=true)

activation_attempts.finding: no licence was returned for the FingerCell component. The service recorded no corresponding entry, which is an indication and not a conclusion: the local transport is not necessarily one the service logs at request level
activation_attempts.route: the official route the delivered tutorials use, after the required runtime initialisation

activation_attempts.finding: the utility describes itself as activating Neurotechnology products from a serial number. Every activation path it offers takes a serial number, either from a file or on the command line, and its only other option generates a device identifier for that same serial-number flow. It exposes no trial, evaluation or unlicensed-activation path, and a trial ships no serial number
activation_attempts.route: the delivered Linux activation utility, asked for its own usage

activation_attempts.finding: the runtime first refused a trial switch set after licensing initialisation, naming the ordering requirement outright; with the order corrected the switch was accepted and read back as enabled, and the subsystem reported LICENSE_NOT_OBTAINED rather than SERVER_OFFLINE
activation_attempts.route: the authoritative route the artifact defines: documented licensing script, trial switch before licensing initialisation, core start-up, then the component licence request

redistribution.basis: A vendor SDK trial is not redistributable, and fpbench redistributes nothing in any case. No archive byte, native module, licence or template enters this repository (docs/adr/0083).

refused_license_actions: patching or replacing a licensing component
reusing another product's entitlement for FingerCell
same_vendor_licensing_isolation: a running Neurotechnology licensing service does not imply a valid FingerCell entitlement; the FingerCell component's own authorization must be observed

stage8e.why_null_and_not_false: no component has been assessed, so Stage 8E made no decision. A false here would read as a research-use refusal nobody made (docs/adr/0095)

trial.network_requirement: to use a trial product a constant internet connection is required
